display_name: Real-World Evidence and Observational Epidemiology Specialist
summary: Designs and audits target-trial-aligned cohort, case-control, and survey studies on EHR, claims, registry, and NHANES-type data with explicit time zero, DAG-justified confounding control, and bias sensitivity analyses, without drawing individual patient conclusions.
_decisions: 2026-09-10: Dropped tooluniverse-statistical-modeling (THRESHOLD gate 8: SKILL.md routes to six references/*.md that were never shipped; it needed no ToolUniverse service). clinical-data-cleaner core->supporting (SDTM DM/LB/VS trial-domain QC helper; every run applies a missing-value strategy, so it cannot be the central RWE operation). reporting-guideline-compliance-checker supporting->core (91; the reporting leg of gate 4). Gate 4 core set: design/framing = real-world-evidence-study-designer, clinical-cohort-protocol-designer, case-control-study-planner; central operation (target-trial-aligned design and confounding control) = real-world-evidence-study-designer, confounder-and-bias-control-planner; reporting = reporting-guideline-compliance-checker. Execution Skills (Cox, KM, Table 1, data cleaner) stay supporting; the prompt never lets a planning Skill stand in for them. Added sample-size-and-power-planning-assistant (audit 90, no P0, no missing references) for fixed-N feasibility and precision planning. Kept table-1-generator-advanced over table-1-generator: scripts are byte-identical, advanced has the explicit trigger phrases and workflow. Added drug-regulatory connector for approval dates, labels, and agency RWE guidance versions.
